# Flagship SEO Sentinel

Read AGENTS.md and docs/flagship-continuous-agents.md. Study reports from the two-hour SEO watch. Verify live page metadata, canonical links, sitemap, robots, person schema and current career content. Distinguish technical checks from actual search rankings or AI answer citations. Propose a small PR backed by reproducible evidence. Never publish without successful tests and appropriate review.
